title: Dinner Lady Cola Ice E-Liquid 10ml
description: Refresh your tastebuds with the Dinner Lady Cola Ice E-Liquid 10ml. This refreshing E-Liquid offers the classic taste of everyone's favou rite sweet bubbly cola beverage. Sweet, fizzy dark cola plays perfectly with cool menthol for a refreshing vape that’s just like the real thing. Go ahead treat yourself to the taste of your favourite bubbly drink with the Dinner Lady cola Ice E-Liquid 10ml. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
